what: A photo filling the opening of a section stays pinned on screen until the section ends, while the content (number rows, etc.) rises beneath and covers it. From when the section’s top edge has gone 10% further above the screen, over 60% of the screen height of scrolling, the overlay on the photo deepens from opacity 0→1 and backdrop blur 0→10px (bound directly to scroll, no curve), so the photo recedes behind a navy haze. On wide screens, the left title block (hold) stays pinned as well.

options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Photo panel to pin (child) — stands at screen height at the start of the Section and stays sticky until the Section ends
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Veil over the photo (inside bg) — parts paint opacity and blur. Color is --fx-veil (default: transparent → accent 80% → accent vertical gradient)
options.[data-fx-part=hold]: Title block to keep together on wide screens (768px and up), optional — place it in a flex row alongside the content
options.start: Position of the section top edge where the curtain starts to darken (from screen top), default -10%
options.span: Distance scrolled until the curtain is fully dark (share of screen height), default .6

use:
Title
    Number Line…
note: The original pins the photo and heading with ScrollTrigger pin (pinSpacing false) — the pin ends within the section, so sticky gives the same position. On phones the heading is not pinned, only the photo (same in the original)

from.where: index.html .tk-num (IN NUMBERS — five rows of numbers over a photo of a seaside industrial city, cover goes transparent → #19435E 80% → #1E396A)
